contract.terms_text: WINTER 2025/2026 – Special Rate Offer. Extra Meals: Breakfast – $10.00, Lunch – $12.00, Dinner - $14.00, Extra Bed - $12.00. Child policy: 0-04 Years FOC & 05-11 Years 50% Discount on Meals. Peak period supplement $10.00 per room per night (20.12.2025 -10.01.2026). X' Mas Eve Supplement – $40.00 & New Year Eve Supplement: $45.00 per person. Guide Policy: Above 15 paying pax, LTG or FTL free of charge. Guide Rates: BB – $35.00, HB – $40.00, FB – $45.00. All above rates are nett, non-commissionable & are in US Dollars. Payment: Full payment to be made prior to guest arrival, unless you are a credit approved partner.
contract.notes: LAST winter — letter of 27 Oct 2025, validity 01 Nov 2025 – 30 Apr 2026, already expired; entered for the coordinator to decide whether to keep it for historical quotations. The letter calls itself a "Special Rate Offer" but is the hotel's full winter travel-agent rate letter (same shape as the summer one), so it is entered as a contract. Two printed periods: 01 Nov – 20 Dec 2025 & 01 – 30 Apr 2026 (one season, two ranges) and 21 Dec 2025 – 31 Mar 2026. BB / HB / FB are all printed, so the extra-meal prices are entered as meal prices only, not as meal deltas. The peak-period supplement (20.12.2025 - 10.01.2026, $10 per room per night) overlaps the start of the second season — that is how the sheet reads. No Perahera supplement on the winter sheet.
